services.title: Roof Repair
services.short: A full repair division for leaks, missing shingles and flashing.
services.text: TrueWorks runs a dedicated Rapid Repair Division, trained to handle a small roof problem with the same precision as a full install.
services.imageAlt: A TrueWorks roofer working on a shingle roof above a lake
body: Even small leaks can lead to big problems, so the repair division is staffed and trained the same way the install crews are. Whether it is a drip in the ceiling or signs of moisture in the attic, the repair team shows up with the tools, the training and the technology to fix it right the first time.

We do not patch, we solve. From missing shingles to flashing failures, every repair is backed by our own inspection process and overseen by an in-house project lead. Most issues are resolved in a single visit.
points: Most repairs resolved in a single visit

faqs.q: How do I know if I just need a repair or a full replacement?
faqs.a: Age is the first thing to look at, since most roofs run 20 to 30 years. After that it is the condition of the shingles, whether they are curling, buckling or missing, how many leaks there are and how much water damage, how much granule loss there is on an asphalt roof, whether the roof sags, whether moss or algae is growing, and whether your energy bills have jumped. An inspection settles it, and ours is free.

faqs.q: How long will the work take?
faqs.a: We finish 95% of our roofing jobs within a single day. It is rare for one to run to a second day.

services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short: A new roof, with the quote, the colour and the warranty settled first.
services.text: We make buying a roof straightforward: get a quote, choose your products, visualise the roof and get approved. Then our own crew installs it.
services.imageAlt: A roof stripped to new decking with a new pipe vent set in place
body: Every replacement starts with a free roof assessment. Our team diagnoses the ventilation in your attic and grades the roof using our own grading system, so the quote is built on what is actually up there rather than an aerial measurement.

On install day your project is overseen by a dedicated on-site project manager. Our crews fabricate custom metal flashings on site and use ring shank nails throughout. Payment is only due after an immaculate cleanup and once you are 100% satisfied.
points: Free roof assessment and attic ventilation diagnosis
Roof graded on our own grading system
TrueArmor Protection System over your home and landscaping
Custom metal flashings fabricated on site
Payment due only after cleanup and your sign-off

faqs.q: What types of roofing materials do you offer?
faqs.a: Metal, tile, slate, composite and fortified roofing systems, for both residential and commercial buildings. We partner with premium brands to keep the options long-lasting and good-looking.

faqs.q: What happens after the roof is on?
faqs.a: Our After Care Program carries complimentary roof inspections and routine maintenance every three years for the life of your warranty.

faqs.q: Can I finance a replacement roof?
faqs.a: Yes. Financing comes through us directly, with an interest-free option over 12 months and a reduced-interest option over as long as 120 months.

faqs.q: How long does a roof last?
faqs.a: It depends on the material. Asphalt shingles run 20 to 30 years, metal roofs 40 to 70 years, tile roofs 50 years and up, and flat roof systems 15 to 25 years. Installation quality and the weather move all of those figures.

faqs.q: Aren't all roofing warranties pretty much the same?
faqs.a: No. The manufacturer sets the terms, and coverage and length vary a lot between them, so it is worth understanding what a specific warranty covers before you choose the product.

services.title: Roof Installation
services.short: Installed by our own crews, with a project manager on site.
services.text: Our installation crews fabricate custom metal flashings on site and install every detail of the roof by hand, under the TrueArmor Protection System.
services.imageAlt: Two TrueWorks crew members laying synthetic underlayment across a roof
body: When it is time for the install, we protect your home and landscaping with our proprietary TrueArmor Protection System before anything comes off the roof. You can watch the crew fabricate the metal flashings on site rather than fit something off the shelf.

Every project is overseen by a dedicated on-site project manager, so there is one person answering for communication and for the result. We use only ring shank nails, and the job is not finished until the cleanup is immaculate.
points: TrueArmor Protection System on the house and landscaping
Custom metal flashings fabricated on site
Immaculate cleanup before payment is due

services.title: Roof Inspection
services.short: A free, drone and AI scan with a live photo link.
services.text: During your free inspection we use drone technology and AI to scan the roof and detect storm damage, and you get a live photo link while we work.
services.imageAlt: A TrueWorks inspector standing on a composite shake roof
body: Book the free roof assessment and we keep you informed from there. You get a notice when we are on the way, and an introduction to the inspector who is coming.

On the roof, the drone and AI scan looks for storm damage, leaks and ventilation problems, and the live photo link means you are not taking our word for anything. The team also diagnoses the ventilation in your attic and grades the roof using our own grading system.
points: Drone and AI scan of the roof surface
Live photo link with geo-tagged photos
A grade from our own roof grading system

faqs.q: What should I expect during my free roof inspection?
faqs.a: Our team uses drones and AI to give a detailed analysis of your roof's condition, identifying potential leaks, storm damage and ventilation issues. You get real-time updates with geo-tagged photos.

faqs.q: How much does an inspection cost?
faqs.a: Our roof inspections and estimates are 100% free.

services.title: Roof Maintenance
services.short: Regular assessments that catch a problem before it escalates.
services.text: Routine inspections and scheduled upkeep, so leaks, damaged shingles and water damage are found and dealt with before they turn into a replacement.
body: Maintenance is a thorough inspection on a regular footing: we look for leaks, damaged shingles and water damage before any of it escalates. Houston's frequent rainfall and high humidity are what make the difference between an annual look and an unplanned replacement.

Scheduled upkeep handles the urgent items and the long-term ones in the same visit, and a final inspection closes it out. Estimates and consultations are free, and the Rapid Repair Division picks up anything small enough to resolve on the spot.
points: Inspection for leaks, damaged shingles and water damage
Scheduled upkeep and a final inspection
Rapid Repair Division for the small items

services.title: Shingle Roofing
services.short: Asphalt and synthetic shingle, built for Houston weather.
services.text: Asphalt shingle and composition roofing from Malarkey, plus F-Wave synthetic shingles, chosen to hold up through a Houston summer and a Houston storm.
services.imageAlt: A stone-fronted Houston home with a new shingle roof over several gables
body: We are a Malarkey Emerald Premium contractor, which is the top tier of their programme, and we install Malarkey's asphalt shingles alongside F-Wave synthetic shingles. Both are picked for the same reason: they handle Houston's tough weather.
If you want hail-resistant shingles or a synthetic that behaves like one, that is a conversation we have at the quote rather than after the fact.

services.title: Metal Roofing
services.short: Metal roofs that look right and last.
services.text: Metal roofing for homes across Houston, including McElroy standing seam, fitted and flashed by our own crews.
services.imageAlt: An aerial view of a standing seam metal roof on a Houston home beside a pool
body: Metal is the roof most of our clients are choosing when they say they never want to replace a roof again. McElroy's standing seam metal roofing looks good and gives strong protection, and the panels are flashed with metal we fabricate on site.
We also work with Euroshield, which is a strong material and useful where a metal look is wanted on a building that takes a beating.
points: Custom metal flashings fabricated on site

services.title: Standing Seam Metal Roofing
services.short: Concealed-fastener standing seam, in McElroy panels.
services.text: Standing seam metal roofing with the fasteners hidden under the seam, installed in McElroy panels with flashings made on site.
services.imageAlt: A standing seam metal roof running up to a brick chimney
body: Standing seam is the metal roof people picture: long panels running from ridge to eave with the fasteners concealed in the seam, so there is no exposed hardware to work loose.
We install McElroy standing seam, and the penetrations and chimney work are flashed with metal our crews bend on site rather than a stock part forced to fit.
points: Chimney and penetration flashings made on site

services.title: Tile Roofing
services.short: Clay, concrete and composite tile, including repairs.
services.text: Clay and concrete tile roofing and tile roof repair, plus Brava and KasselWood composite tile that carries the look at a lighter weight.
services.imageAlt: A Houston home with a clay tile roof above stucco walls
body: Tile is a Houston roof with a long history, and it needs a crew that knows how the underlayment and the flashing work beneath it. We do clay and concrete tile roofs and clay and concrete tile roof repair.
We are a Brava Preferred Contractor, and we install KasselWood composite tile as well, which is how we won a Spanish Barrel Tile Roof Excellence Award.
points: Clay and concrete tile roof repair
Slate roofing and slate roof repair

services.title: Attic Ventilation
services.short: Solar attic fans and soffit vents for a cooler attic.
services.text: Solar-powered attic ventilation that cuts heat and moisture without adding to your electric bill, paired with soffit vents and a ventilation-grade assessment.
services.imageAlt: A solar-powered attic fan mounted on a shingle roof
body: Your attic should not feel like a furnace. If it does, you are losing comfort and money. Our energy-smart attic fans kick in on their own when the temperature rises, quietly pulling hot air out and replacing it with cooler airflow.

Paired with soffit vents and a ventilation-grade assessment, this turns the attic into a buffer rather than a heat trap, which protects the roof and the insulation and takes load off the air conditioning.

services.title: Storm Damage Roof Restoration
services.short: Hail and wind damage found, documented and restored.
services.text: From granule loss after hail to repairs after high winds, we document the damage with a drone and AI scan and work with your insurance company from there.
services.imageAlt: An aerial view of a Houston home with a new shingle roof
body: Houston is no stranger to volatile weather, and a roof takes the first hit. Granule loss from hail and lifted or torn shingles from high winds are the two we see most, and neither is easy to judge from the yard.

The free assessment uses a drone and AI to scan the roof for storm damage, and the live photo link means you see the evidence as it is found. Navigating an insurance claim on a storm-damaged roof is complicated, so our team guides you through each step of dealing with your insurer.
points: Drone and AI scan with geo-tagged photos
Insurance claim guidance from start to finish
Repair or full restoration once the claim settles

faqs.q: Do you handle roofing insurance claims?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team works closely with your insurance company to streamline the claims process, so the repair or replacement is managed and covered properly.

faqs.q: Will my homeowner's insurance pay to have my roof repaired?
faqs.a: Storm damage is generally covered, subject to your deductible. What matters is getting a professional assessment, understanding how the claim works, choosing an ethical contractor and having someone advocating for you while the claim is open. We guide you through all of it.

faqs.q: Someone offered me a free roof and said I would not have to pay my deductible. Do you do that?
faqs.a: No. Texas law prohibits waiving a homeowner's deductible, and doing it is insurance fraud. We will not, and we would not work with a company that offers it.

faqs.q: How can I tell if my roof has hail damage?
faqs.a: Book the free inspection and we will tell you, with photographs of what we found if you want them. If you have already called your insurer, give us notice of the adjuster's visit and we will be there for it.

services.title: Emergency Roof Repair
services.short: A fast response when the roof has opened up.
services.text: High winds, impact damage or a storm can turn a roof into an emergency. We move quickly to make it safe and sound again.
services.imageAlt: A blue tarp covering a storm-damaged roof on a Houston home
body: A roofing emergency left alone gets worse, and the damage stops being about the roof and starts being about the house. We handle the problem quickly, with the aim of making your roof safe and strong again as fast as possible.
Our repair technicians use the same materials and the same standards as a full install: Malarkey, Tamko Titan, McElroy standing seam and Euroshield, whichever your roof is built from.
points: Same materials and standards as a full install

services.title: Fortified Roofing
services.short: An IBHS Fortified roof, built to the standard insurers reward.
services.text: A Fortified roof is tested and verified to the IBHS Fortified Home standard, and many Texas insurers discount a policy once one is on the house.
services.imageAlt: An aerial view of a large Houston home with a new tile roof
body: TrueWorks leads the way in Houston on Fortified roofing systems, which are scientifically researched and engineered for the weather this city actually gets. A Fortified roof is built to endure Category 1 to 3 hurricanes and the severe storm activity that is normal in Texas.

Our team is trained in the latest IBHS protocols and uses materials that exceed local building codes: sealed roof decks, reinforced drip edges that resist wind and water intrusion, and high-performance underlayment and shingles tested under real-world hurricane conditions.

Many insurers reward a Fortified roof upgrade with a substantial discount, and the figure their own research points to is 30% to 55% off premiums. Not every carrier offers it, so check with yours, or let us help you work it out.
points: Existing roofs can often be upgraded to the standard

faqs.q: Is a Fortified roof more expensive than a traditional roof?
faqs.a: The upfront cost may be slightly higher, but a Fortified roof offers long-term savings on insurance and on storm repairs.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade my current roof to a Fortified one?
faqs.a: Yes. In many cases we can modify your existing roof structure to meet the IBHS Fortified Roof standard.

faqs.q: Do all insurers offer discounts for Fortified roofs?
faqs.a: Not all, but many leading insurance providers in Texas do. Check with your carrier, or let us help guide you through it.

services.title: Commercial Roofing
services.short: TPO, coatings, flat and foam roofs for Houston business.
services.text: Commercial roof repair, installation and coating for low-slope and flat buildings, including TPO, foam and Duro-Last PVC.
services.imageAlt: A long low-slope roof on a stone commercial building in Houston
body: We work on commercial and low-slope roofs across Houston: repair, full installation, and roof coating where the existing deck is sound and what it needs is a new surface.

We are a Castagra certified applicator, and the systems we install include IKO TPO and Duro-Last PVC. Tamko Titan and Euroshield are strong materials that suit larger commercial buildings such as shopping centres.
points: Commercial roof coating, Castagra certified applicator

about.title: Meet the Green Team
text: Joel and Laura started TrueWorks in 2020, right during Covid. Joel had been in the industry for several years and saw the need for a company that installed roofs that actually last: one that communicated well, left job sites clean, and treated people and their homes as if they were its own. They had a newborn and worked out of a one-bedroom apartment.

It was a struggle at first, but they kept going above and beyond for clients and built a team that believed in the mission. They have always strived to do the right thing no matter what, even when it meant losing money on a job, and when they have made mistakes they have owned them and made them right.

Joel also serves as the current President of HARCA, the Houston Area Roofing Contractors Association. Laura is a mom and a yoga instructor, and on many jobs she is the one on the roof taking the photos and writing the quote.

facts.heading: What a roof costs in Houston
facts.text: Most homeowners spend between $10,000 and $20,000. By material that is roughly $4.00 to $6.50 a square foot for asphalt shingles, $5.50 to $9.00 for a flat or low-slope roof, $8.00 to $14.00 for metal and $12.00 to $20.00 for tile. Roof size, pitch, labour complexity, permits, tearing off the old roof and extras like gutters and skylights all move the figure, and labour alone is 40% to 60% of the total.
